import math

class Expression(string kind, numerator := 0, denominator := 1, name := "", int[] children := [])

class Context()
    Expression[] nodes := []
    definitions := map<string, int>()
    string[] tokens := []
    position := 0

bool digit(string character)
    return "0123456789".contains(character)

bool lowercase(string character)
    return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

bool uppercase(string character)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(character)

bool function_name(string name)
    return name == "sin" or name == "cos" or name == "tan" or name == "exp" or name == "ln" or name == "sqrt"

bool variable_name(string name)
    if #name == 0 or not lowercase(name[0]) or function_name(name)
        return false
    for: 1 <= i < int(#name)
        if not lowercase(name[i]) and not digit(name[i])
            return false
    return true

bool definition_name(string name)
    if #name == 0 or not uppercase(name[0])
        return false
    for: 1 <= i < int(#name)
        if not uppercase(name[i]) and not digit(name[i])
            return false
    return true

string strip(string text)
    start := 0
    finish := int(#text)
    while start < finish and text[start] == " "
        start += 1
    while finish > start and text[finish - 1] == " "
        finish -= 1
    return text[start:<finish]

int absolute(int number)
    return if number < 0 then -number else number

int gcd_value(int first, int second)
    a := absolute(first)
    b := absolute(second)
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

int store(Context &context, Expression expression)
    index := int(#context.nodes)
    context.nodes = context.nodes.append(expression)
    return index

int rational(Context &context, int p, q := 1)
    if q < 0
        p = -p
        q = -q
    divisor := gcd_value(p, q)
    return store(&context, Expression("number", p / divisor, q / divisor))

int constant(Context &context, int value)
    return rational(&context, value)

int make_variable(Context &context, string name)
    return store(&context, Expression("variable", name = name))

int make_tree(Context &context, string operator, int[] args)
    return store(&context, Expression("ast", name = operator, children = args))

int make_form(Context &context, string kind, int[] args, name := "")
    return store(&context, Expression(kind, name = name, children = args))

int number_one(Context &context)
    return constant(&context, 1)

int number_zero(Context &context)
    return constant(&context, 0)

bool is_number(Context context, int id)
    return context.nodes[id].kind == "number"

bool is_zero(Context context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return value.kind == "number" and value.numerator == 0

bool is_one(Context context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return value.kind == "number" and value.numerator == value.denominator

bool is_integer(Context context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return value.kind == "number" and value.denominator == 1

bool is_half(Context context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return value.kind == "number" and value.numerator == 1 and value.denominator == 2

int base_id(Context context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return if value.kind == "power" then value.children[0] else id

int exponent_id(Context &context, int id)
    value := context.nodes[id]
    return if value.kind == "power" then value.children[1] else number_one(&context)

int kind_order(string kind)
    if kind == "variable"
        return 0
    if kind == "sum"
        return 1
    if kind == "product"
        return 2
    if kind == "power"
        return 3
    if kind == "function"
        return 4
    return 5

int comparison(int left, int right)
    return if left < right then -1 elif left > right then 1 else 0

int text_comparison(string left, string right)
    int[] left_points := left.codepoints()
    int[] right_points := right.codepoints()
    for: i < #left_points
        if i >= #right_points
            return 1
        order := comparison(left_points[i], right_points[i])
        if order != 0
            return order
    return if #left_points < #right_points then -1 else 0

int compare_expression(Context context, int left, int right)
    a := context.nodes[left]
    b := context.nodes[right]
    order := comparison(kind_order(a.kind), kind_order(b.kind))
    if order != 0
        return order
    if a.kind == "number"
        return comparison(a.numerator * b.denominator, b.numerator * a.denominator)
    if a.kind == "variable"
        return text_comparison(a.name, b.name)
    if a.kind == "function"
        names := text_comparison(a.name, b.name)
        if names != 0
            return names
    limit := if #a.children < #b.children then int(#a.children) else int(#b.children)
    for: i < limit
        result := compare_expression(context, a.children[i], b.children[i])
        if result != 0
            return result
    return comparison(int(#a.children), int(#b.children))

bool equivalent(Context context, int left, int right)
    return compare_expression(context, left, right) == 0

int[] monomial(Context context, int id)
    term := context.nodes[id]
    if term.kind == "number"
        return []
    if term.kind == "product"
        if is_number(context, term.children[0])
            return term.children[1:]
        return term.children
    return [id]

int coefficient_numerator(Context context, int id)
    term := context.nodes[id]
    if term.kind == "number"
        return term.numerator
    if term.kind == "product" and is_number(context, term.children[0])
        return context.nodes[term.children[0]].numerator
    return 1

int coefficient_denominator(Context context, int id)
    term := context.nodes[id]
    if term.kind == "number"
        return term.denominator
    if term.kind == "product" and is_number(context, term.children[0])
        return context.nodes[term.children[0]].denominator
    return 1

bool same_sequence(Context context, int[] left, int[] right)
    if #left != #right
        return false
    for: i < int(#left)
        if not equivalent(context, left[i], right[i])
            return false
    return true

int exponent_comparison(Context context, int left, int right)
    if is_number(context, left) and not is_number(context, right)
        return -1
    if is_number(context, right) and not is_number(context, left)
        return 1
    return compare_expression(context, left, right)

bool contains_id(Context context, int[] items, int target)
    for item := items[]
        if equivalent(context, item, target)
            return true
    return false

int compare_terms(Context &context, int first, int second)
    a := monomial(context, first)
    b := monomial(context, second)
    int[] bases := []
    for factor := a.concat(b)[]
        base := base_id(context, factor)
        if not contains_id(context, bases, base)
            bases = bases.append(base)
    for: 1 <= i < int(#bases)
        j := i
        while j > 0 and compare_expression(context, bases[j], bases[j - 1]) < 0
            saved := bases[j]
            bases[j] = bases[j - 1]
            bases[j - 1] = saved
            j -= 1
    for base := bases[]
        x := number_zero(&context)
        y := number_zero(&context)
        for factor := a[]
            if equivalent(context, base_id(context, factor), base)
                x = exponent_id(&context, factor)
                break
        for factor := b[]
            if equivalent(context, base_id(context, factor), base)
                y = exponent_id(&context, factor)
                break
        diff := exponent_comparison(context, x, y)
        if diff != 0
            return -diff
    return 0

int make_product(Context &context, int p, int q, int[] factors)
    if #factors == 0
        return rational(&context, p, q)
    if p != q
        factors = [rational(&context, p, q)].concat(factors)
    if #factors == 1
        return factors[0]
    return make_form(&context, "product", factors)

int | error combine_product(Context &context, int[] arguments);
int | error normal_power(Context &context, int b, int x);

int | error combine_sum(Context &context, int[] arguments)
    int[] terms := []
    for id := arguments[]
        value := context.nodes[id]
        if value.kind == "sum"
            terms = terms.concat(value.children)
        elif value.kind == "product" and #value.children == 2 and is_number(context, value.children[0]) and context.nodes[value.children[1]].kind == "sum"
            for child := context.nodes[value.children[1]].children[]
                terms = terms.append(try combine_product(&context, [value.children[0], child]))
        else
            terms = terms.append(id)
    int[][] monomials := []
    int[] numerators := []
    int[] denominators := []
    for term := terms[]
        pieces := monomial(context, term)
        p := coefficient_numerator(context, term)
        q := coefficient_denominator(context, term)
        found := -1
        for: i < int(#monomials)
            if same_sequence(context, monomials[i], pieces)
                found = i
                break
        if found < 0
            monomials = monomials.append(pieces)
            numerators = numerators.append(p)
            denominators = denominators.append(q)
        else
            n := numerators[found] * q + p * denominators[found]
            d := denominators[found] * q
            divisor := gcd_value(n, d)
            numerators[found] = n / divisor
            denominators[found] = d / divisor
    int[] built := []
    for: i < int(#monomials)
        if numerators[i] != 0
            built = built.append(make_product(&context, numerators[i], denominators[i], monomials[i]))
    for: 1 <= i < int(#built)
        j := i
        while j > 0 and compare_terms(&context, built[j], built[j - 1]) < 0
            saved := built[j]
            built[j] = built[j - 1]
            built[j - 1] = saved
            j -= 1
    if #built == 0
        return number_zero(&context)
    if #built == 1
        return built[0]
    return make_form(&context, "sum", built)

int | error combine_product(Context &context, int[] arguments)
    pending := arguments
    while true
        int[] flattened := []
        for id := pending[]
            item := context.nodes[id]
            if item.kind == "product"
                flattened = flattened.concat(item.children)
            else
                flattened = flattened.append(id)
        coefficient_p := 1
        coefficient_q := 1
        int[] bases := []
        int[][] groups := []
        for id := flattened[]
            factor := context.nodes[id]
            if factor.kind == "number"
                coefficient_p *= factor.numerator
                coefficient_q *= factor.denominator
                divisor := gcd_value(coefficient_p, coefficient_q)
                coefficient_p /= divisor
                coefficient_q /= divisor
            else
                base := base_id(context, id)
                found := -1
                for: i < int(#bases)
                    if equivalent(context, bases[i], base)
                        found = i
                        break
                if found < 0
                    bases = bases.append(base)
                    groups = groups.append([id])
                else
                    groups[found] = groups[found].append(id)
        if coefficient_p == 0
            return number_zero(&context)
        int[] reduced := []
        for: i < int(#groups)
            if #groups[i] == 1
                reduced = reduced.append(groups[i][0])
            else
                int[] exponents := []
                for factor := groups[i][]
                    exponents = exponents.append(exponent_id(&context, factor))
                combined := try combine_sum(&context, exponents)
                reduced = reduced.append(try normal_power(&context, bases[i], combined))
        again := false
        int[] checked := []
        for item := reduced[]
            kind := context.nodes[item].kind
            if kind == "number" or kind == "product"
                again = true
            b := base_id(context, item)
            if contains_id(context, checked, b)
                again = true
            checked = checked.append(b)
        if again
            pending = [rational(&context, coefficient_p, coefficient_q)].concat(reduced)
            continue
        for: 1 <= i < int(#reduced)
            j := i
            while j > 0 and compare_expression(context, base_id(context, reduced[j]), base_id(context, reduced[j - 1])) < 0
                saved := reduced[j]
                reduced[j] = reduced[j - 1]
                reduced[j - 1] = saved
                j -= 1
        return make_product(&context, coefficient_p, coefficient_q, reduced)

int perfect_root(int value, int degree)
    if value == 1
        return 1
    if degree > 20
        return -1
    for: 1 <= candidate <= 1000
        result := 1
        for: j < degree
            result *= candidate
            if result > value
                break
        if result == value
            return candidate
        if result > value
            break
    return -1

int | error rational_power(Context &context, int numerator, int denominator, int exponent)
    if exponent < 0
        if numerator == 0
            return error("division by zero")
        saved := numerator
        numerator = denominator
        denominator = saved
        exponent = -exponent
    p := 1
    q := 1
    while exponent > 0
        if exponent % 2 == 1
            p *= numerator
            q *= denominator
        exponent /= 2
        if exponent > 0
            numerator *= numerator
            denominator *= denominator
    return rational(&context, p, q)

int | error normal_power(Context &context, int b, int x)
    if is_zero(context, x)
        return number_one(&context)
    if is_one(context, x)
        return b
    base := context.nodes[b]
    exponent := context.nodes[x]
    if base.kind == "number"
        if is_one(context, b)
            return number_one(&context)
        if exponent.kind == "number"
            if base.numerator == 0
                if exponent.numerator > 0
                    return number_zero(&context)
                return error("division by zero")
            if exponent.denominator == 1
                return rational_power(&context, base.numerator, base.denominator, exponent.numerator)
            if base.numerator > 0
                root_p := perfect_root(base.numerator, exponent.denominator)
                root_q := perfect_root(base.denominator, exponent.denominator)
                if root_p > 0 and root_q > 0
                    return rational_power(&context, root_p, root_q, exponent.numerator)
    elif is_integer(context, x)
        if base.kind == "power"
            next := try combine_product(&context, [base.children[1], x])
            return normal_power(&context, base.children[0], next)
        if base.kind == "product"
            int[] terms := []
            for factor := base.children[]
                terms = terms.append(try normal_power(&context, factor, x))
            return combine_product(&context, terms)
    return make_form(&context, "power", [b, x])

int | error normal_function(Context &context, string name, int argument)
    if name == "sqrt"
        return normal_power(&context, argument, rational(&context, 1, 2))
    if is_zero(context, argument)
        if name == "sin" or name == "tan"
            return number_zero(&context)
        if name == "cos" or name == "exp"
            return number_one(&context)
    if name == "ln" and is_one(context, argument)
        return number_zero(&context)
    if (name == "sin" or name == "cos" or name == "tan") and coefficient_numerator(context, argument) < 0
        changed := try combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), argument])
        transformed := try normal_function(&context, name, changed)
        if name == "cos"
            return transformed
        return combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), transformed])
    value := context.nodes[argument]
    if value.kind == "function"
        if (name == "exp" and value.name == "ln") or (name == "ln" and value.name == "exp")
            return value.children[0]
    return make_form(&context, "function", [argument], name)

bool includes_name(string[] names, string name)
    for item := names[]
        if item == name
            return true
    return false

string[] variables(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "variable"
        return [value.name]
    string[] names := []
    for child := value.children[]
        for name := variables(context, child)[]
            if not includes_name(names, name)
                names = names.append(name)
    return names.sorted()

int | error derivative(Context &context, int expression, string variable)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "number"
        return number_zero(&context)
    if value.kind == "variable"
        return constant(&context, if value.name == variable then 1 else 0)
    if value.kind == "sum"
        int[] terms := []
        for child := value.children[]
            terms = terms.append(try derivative(&context, child, variable))
        return combine_sum(&context, terms)
    if value.kind == "product"
        int[] terms := []
        for: i < int(#value.children)
            factors := value.children
            factors[i] = try derivative(&context, factors[i], variable)
            terms = terms.append(try combine_product(&context, factors))
        return combine_sum(&context, terms)
    if value.kind == "power"
        b := value.children[0]
        x := value.children[1]
        if not includes_name(variables(context, x), variable)
            x_minus_one := try combine_sum(&context, [x, constant(&context, -1)])
            return combine_product(&context, [
                x,
                try normal_power(&context, b, x_minus_one),
                try derivative(&context, b, variable)])
        if not includes_name(variables(context, b), variable)
            return combine_product(&context, [
                expression,
                try normal_function(&context, "ln", b),
                try derivative(&context, x, variable)])
        first := try combine_product(&context, [
            try derivative(&context, x, variable),
            try normal_function(&context, "ln", b)])
        second := try combine_product(&context, [
            x,
            try derivative(&context, b, variable),
            try normal_power(&context, b, constant(&context, -1))])
        return combine_product(&context, [expression, try combine_sum(&context, [first, second])])
    a := value.children[0]
    inner := number_zero(&context)
    if value.name == "sin"
        inner = try normal_function(&context, "cos", a)
    elif value.name == "cos"
        inner = try combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), try normal_function(&context, "sin", a)])
    elif value.name == "tan"
        inner = try normal_power(&context, try normal_function(&context, "cos", a), constant(&context, -2))
    elif value.name == "exp"
        inner = expression
    else
        inner = try normal_power(&context, a, constant(&context, -1))
    return combine_product(&context, [inner, try derivative(&context, a, variable)])

int | error substitute(Context &context, int expression, string[] names, int[] replacements)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "number"
        return expression
    if value.kind == "variable"
        for: i < int(#names)
            if value.name == names[i]
                return replacements[i]
        return expression
    int[] children := []
    for child := value.children[]
        children = children.append(try substitute(&context, child, names, replacements))
    if value.kind == "sum"
        return combine_sum(&context, children)
    if value.kind == "product"
        return combine_product(&context, children)
    if value.kind == "power"
        return normal_power(&context, children[0], children[1])
    return normal_function(&context, value.name, children[0])

int | error distribute(Context &context, int left, int right)
    a := context.nodes[left]
    b := context.nodes[right]
    int[] aa := if a.kind == "sum" then a.children else [left]
    int[] bb := if b.kind == "sum" then b.children else [right]
    int[] terms := []
    for first := aa[]
        for second := bb[]
            terms = terms.append(try combine_product(&context, [first, second]))
    return combine_sum(&context, terms)

int | error expand(Context &context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "number" or value.kind == "variable"
        return expression
    int[] children := []
    for child := value.children[]
        children = children.append(try expand(&context, child))
    if value.kind == "sum"
        return combine_sum(&context, children)
    if value.kind == "function"
        return normal_function(&context, value.name, children[0])
    if value.kind == "product"
        result := children[0]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#children)
            result = try distribute(&context, result, children[i])
        return result
    b := children[0]
    x := children[1]
    if context.nodes[b].kind == "sum" and is_integer(context, x) and context.nodes[x].numerator > 0
        result := b
        for: 1 <= i < context.nodes[x].numerator
            result = try distribute(&context, result, b)
        return result
    return normal_power(&context, b, x)

bool negative_power(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind != "power"
        return false
    exponent := context.nodes[value.children[1]]
    return exponent.kind == "number" and exponent.numerator < 0

string show(Context context, int expression);

bool atomic(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "variable" or value.kind == "function"
        return true
    if value.kind == "number"
        return value.denominator == 1 and value.numerator >= 0
    return value.kind == "power" and is_half(context, value.children[1])

string show_atom(Context context, int expression)
    text := show(context, expression)
    return if atomic(context, expression) then text else "(" + text + ")"

string show_power(Context context, int b, int x)
    if is_half(context, x)
        return "sqrt(" + show(context, b) + ")"
    return show_atom(context, b) + "^" + show_atom(context, x)

string show_factor(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "sum"
        return "(" + show(context, expression) + ")"
    if value.kind == "power"
        return show_power(context, value.children[0], value.children[1])
    return show(context, expression)

string quotient(Context context, int p, int q, int[] factors)
    string[] top := []
    string[] bottom := []
    if absolute(p) != 1
        top = top.append(string(absolute(p)))
    if q != 1
        bottom = bottom.append(string(q))
    for id := factors[]
        if negative_power(context, id)
            factor := context.nodes[id]
            power := context.nodes[factor.children[1]]
            numerator := -power.numerator
            denominator := power.denominator
            if numerator == denominator
                bottom = bottom.append(show_factor(context, factor.children[0]))
            else
                exponent_text := if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "(" + string(numerator) + "/" + string(denominator) + ")"
                factor_text := if numerator == 1 and denominator == 2 then "sqrt(" + show(context, factor.children[0]) + ")" else show_atom(context, factor.children[0]) + "^" + exponent_text
                bottom = bottom.append(factor_text)
        else
            top = top.append(show_factor(context, id))
    rendered := if #top == 0 then "1" else top.join("*")
    if #bottom == 1
        rendered += "/" + bottom[0]
    elif #bottom >= 2
        rendered += "/(" + bottom.join("*") + ")"
    return if p < 0 then "-" + rendered else rendered

string show(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "number"
        return string(value.numerator) + (if value.denominator == 1 then "" else "/" + string(value.denominator))
    if value.kind == "variable"
        return value.name
    if value.kind == "function"
        return value.name + "(" + show(context, value.children[0]) + ")"
    if value.kind == "power"
        if negative_power(context, expression)
            return quotient(context, 1, 1, [expression])
        return show_power(context, value.children[0], value.children[1])
    if value.kind == "product"
        return quotient(context, coefficient_numerator(context, expression), coefficient_denominator(context, expression), monomial(context, expression))
    text := ""
    for: i < int(#value.children)
        part := show(context, value.children[i])
        if i == 0
            text = part
        elif part.starts_with("-")
            text += " - " + part[1:]
        else
            text += " + " + part
    return text

real64 | error numerical_value(Context context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind == "number"
        return real64(value.numerator) / real64(value.denominator)
    if value.kind == "sum"
        real64 result := 0.0
        for child := value.children[]
            result += try numerical_value(context, child)
        return result
    if value.kind == "product"
        real64 result := 1.0
        for child := value.children[]
            result *= try numerical_value(context, child)
        return result
    if value.kind == "power"
        b := try numerical_value(context, value.children[0])
        x := try numerical_value(context, value.children[1])
        integer_exponent := is_integer(context, value.children[1]) or (not is_number(context, value.children[1]) and x == real64(math.floor(x)))
        if b < 0.0 and not integer_exponent
            return error("domain error")
        return if is_half(context, value.children[1]) then math.sqrt(b) else b ^ x
    a := try numerical_value(context, value.children[0])
    if value.name == "sin"
        return math.sin(a)
    if value.name == "cos"
        return math.cos(a)
    if value.name == "tan"
        return math.tan(a)
    if value.name == "exp"
        return math.exp(a)
    if a <= 0.0
        return error("domain error")
    return math.log(a)

string approx(real64 value)
    scaled := math.floor(math.abs(value) * 1000000.0 + 0.5)
    whole := scaled / 1000000
    decimals := string(scaled % 1000000)
    decimals = "0" * nat(6 - int(#decimals)) + decimals
    return (if value < 0.0 then "-" else "") + string(whole) + "." + decimals

string[] | error tokenize(string text)
    string[] tokens := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#text)
        character := text[cursor]
        if character == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        start := cursor
        if digit(character)
            while cursor < int(#text) and digit(text[cursor])
                cursor += 1
        elif lowercase(character)
            while cursor < int(#text) and (lowercase(text[cursor]) or digit(text[cursor]))
                cursor += 1
        elif uppercase(character)
            while cursor < int(#text) and (uppercase(text[cursor]) or digit(text[cursor]))
                cursor += 1
        elif "+-*/^()".contains(character)
            cursor += 1
        else
            return error("invalid character '{character}'")
        tokens = tokens.append(text[start:<cursor])
    return tokens

string look(Context context)
    return if context.position < int(#context.tokens) then context.tokens[context.position] else ""

string unexpected(Context context)
    return if context.position == int(#context.tokens) then "unexpected end of expression" else "unexpected '{look(context)}'"

bool accept(Context &context, string word)
    if look(context) != word
        return false
    context.position += 1
    return true

void | error expect(Context &context, string word)
    if not accept(&context, word)
        return error(unexpected(context))
    return void

int | error parse_expression_tree(Context &context);

int | error parse_atom(Context &context)
    if accept(&context, "(")
        inside := try parse_expression_tree(&context)
        try expect(&context, ")")
        return inside
    word := look(context)
    if word == ""
        return error(unexpected(context))
    if digit(word[0])
        context.position += 1
        return constant(&context, int(word))
    if uppercase(word[0])
        context.position += 1
        match context.definitions.get(word)
            int found
                return found
            none
                return error("undefined name '{word}'")
    if lowercase(word[0])
        context.position += 1
        if not function_name(word)
            return make_variable(&context, word)
        try expect(&context, "(")
        inner := try parse_expression_tree(&context)
        try expect(&context, ")")
        return make_tree(&context, word, [inner])
    return error(unexpected(context))

int | error parse_unary(Context &context)
    if accept(&context, "-")
        return make_tree(&context, "neg", [try parse_unary(&context)])
    left := try parse_atom(&context)
    if accept(&context, "^")
        return make_tree(&context, "^", [left, try parse_unary(&context)])
    return left

int | error parse_term(Context &context)
    left := try parse_unary(&context)
    while look(context) == "*" or look(context) == "/"
        operator := look(context)
        context.position += 1
        left = make_tree(&context, operator, [left, try parse_unary(&context)])
    return left

int | error parse_expression_tree(Context &context)
    left := try parse_term(&context)
    while look(context) == "+" or look(context) == "-"
        operator := look(context)
        context.position += 1
        left = make_tree(&context, operator, [left, try parse_term(&context)])
    return left

int | error evaluate_tree(Context &context, int expression)
    value := context.nodes[expression]
    if value.kind != "ast"
        return expression
    int[] children := []
    for child := value.children[]
        children = children.append(try evaluate_tree(&context, child))
    if value.name == "+"
        return combine_sum(&context, children)
    if value.name == "-"
        right := try combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), children[1]])
        return combine_sum(&context, [children[0], right])
    if value.name == "*"
        return combine_product(&context, children)
    if value.name == "/"
        inverse := try normal_power(&context, children[1], constant(&context, -1))
        return combine_product(&context, [children[0], inverse])
    if value.name == "^"
        return normal_power(&context, children[0], children[1])
    if value.name == "neg"
        return combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), children[0]])
    return normal_function(&context, value.name, children[0])

int | error parse(Context &context, string text)
    context.tokens = try tokenize(text)
    context.position = 0
    tree := try parse_expression_tree(&context)
    if context.position < int(#context.tokens)
        return error(unexpected(context))
    return evaluate_tree(&context, tree)

bool literal_format(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    trimmed := if text[0] == "-" then text[1:] else text
    pieces := trimmed.split("/")
    if #pieces == 0 or #pieces > 2
        return false
    for piece := pieces[]
        if #piece == 0
            return false
        for: i < int(#piece)
            if not digit(piece[i])
                return false
    return true

int | error literal(Context &context, string text)
    if not literal_format(text)
        return error("invalid number '{text}'")
    pieces := text.split("/")
    p := int(pieces[0])
    int q := if #pieces == 2 then int(pieces[1]) else 1
    if q == 0
        return error("division by zero")
    return rational(&context, p, q)

string | error variable_field(string text)
    if variable_name(text)
        return text
    return error("invalid variable '{text}'")

int | error order_field(string text)
    if #text != 1 or not "12345678".contains(text)
        return error("invalid order '{text}'")
    return int(text)

string[] | error process_command(Context &context, string line)
    split := -1
    for: i < int(#line)
        if line[i] == " "
            split = i
            break
    command := if split < 0 then line else line[0:<split]
    arguments := if split < 0 then "" else line[split + 1:]
    if command == "LET"
        match arguments.find("=")
            nat index
                name := strip(arguments[0:<int(index)])
                if not definition_name(name)
                    return error("invalid name '{name}'")
                expression := try parse(&context, strip(arguments[int(index) + 1:]))
                .context.definitions.set(name, expression)
                return ["{name} = {show(context, expression)}"]
            none
                return error("wrong number of arguments")
    if not includes_name(["SIMPLIFY", "EXPAND", "DIFF", "DIFFN", "GRAD", "HESSIAN", "IMPLICIT", "SUBST", "EVAL", "TANGENT", "LIMIT", "TAYLOR"], command)
        return error("unknown command {command}")
    string[] fields := []
    if split >= 0
        for word := arguments.split(";")[]
            fields = fields.append(strip(word))
    required := 1
    if command == "DIFF"
        required = 2
    elif command == "DIFFN" or command == "IMPLICIT" or command == "SUBST" or command == "TANGENT" or command == "LIMIT"
        required = 3
    elif command == "TAYLOR"
        required = 4
    if command == "EVAL"
        if #fields != 1 and #fields != 2
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
    elif int(#fields) != required
        return error("wrong number of arguments")
    expression := try parse(&context, fields[0])
    if command == "SIMPLIFY"
        return ["simplified: " + show(context, expression)]
    if command == "EXPAND"
        return ["expanded: " + show(context, try expand(&context, expression))]
    if command == "GRAD" or command == "HESSIAN"
        names := variables(context, expression)
        if #names == 0
            return ["no variables"]
        string[] lines := []
        for: i < int(#names)
            first := try derivative(&context, expression, names[i])
            if command == "GRAD"
                lines = lines.append("d/d{names[i]} = {show(context, first)}")
            else
                for: i <= j < int(#names)
                    second := try derivative(&context, first, names[j])
                    lines = lines.append("d2/d{names[i]}d{names[j]} = {show(context, second)}")
        return lines
    if command == "EVAL"
        string[] names := []
        int[] numbers := []
        if #fields == 2
            for word := fields[1].split(" ")[]
                if word == ""
                    continue
                parts := word.split("=")
                if #parts != 2 or not variable_name(parts[0]) or not literal_format(parts[1])
                    return error("invalid assignment '{word}'")
                value := try literal(&context, parts[1])
                if includes_name(names, parts[0])
                    return error("duplicate variable {parts[0]}")
                names = names.append(parts[0])
                numbers = numbers.append(value)
        for name := variables(context, expression)[]
            if not includes_name(names, name)
                return error("no value for {name}")
        result := try substitute(&context, expression, names, numbers)
        if is_number(context, result)
            return ["exact: " + show(context, result)]
        return ["approx: " + approx(try numerical_value(context, result))]
    variable := try variable_field(fields[1])
    if command == "DIFF"
        return ["d/d{variable} = {show(context, try derivative(&context, expression, variable))}"]
    if command == "DIFFN"
        order := try order_field(fields[2])
        string[] results := []
        for: 1 <= k <= order
            expression = try derivative(&context, expression, variable)
            results = results.append("d^{k}/d{variable}^{k} = {show(context, expression)}")
        return results
    if command == "IMPLICIT"
        other := try variable_field(fields[2])
        if variable == other
            return error("same variable")
        a := try derivative(&context, expression, variable)
        b := try derivative(&context, expression, other)
        quotient_result := try combine_product(&context, [
            constant(&context, -1),
            a,
            try normal_power(&context, b, constant(&context, -1))])
        return ["d{other}/d{variable} = {show(context, quotient_result)}"]
    if command == "SUBST"
        replacement := try parse(&context, fields[2])
        transformed := try substitute(&context, expression, [variable], [replacement])
        return ["substituted: " + show(context, transformed)]
    point := try literal(&context, fields[2])
    if command == "TANGENT"
        slope := try substitute(&context, try derivative(&context, expression, variable), [variable], [point])
        y := try substitute(&context, expression, [variable], [point])
        v := make_variable(&context, variable)
        q := context.nodes[point]
        negative_point := rational(&context, -q.numerator, q.denominator)
        tangent := try combine_sum(&context, [
            try combine_product(&context, [slope, v]),
            y,
            try combine_product(&context, [negative_point, slope])])
        tangent_line := "tangent: y = " + show(context, tangent)
        if is_zero(context, slope)
            return [tangent_line, "normal: {variable} = {show(context, point)}"]
        reciprocal := try normal_power(&context, slope, constant(&context, -1))
        normal := try combine_sum(&context, [
            try combine_product(&context, [constant(&context, -1), reciprocal, v]),
            y,
            try combine_product(&context, [point, reciprocal])])
        return [tangent_line, "normal: y = " + show(context, normal)]
    if command == "LIMIT"
        form := context.nodes[expression]
        int[] factors := if form.kind == "product" then form.children else [expression]
        int[] tops := []
        int[] bottoms := []
        for factor := factors[]
            if negative_power(context, factor)
                item := context.nodes[factor]
                n := context.nodes[item.children[1]]
                positive := rational(&context, -n.numerator, n.denominator)
                bottoms = bottoms.append(try normal_power(&context, item.children[0], positive))
            else
                tops = tops.append(factor)
        numerator := try combine_product(&context, tops)
        denominator := try combine_product(&context, bottoms)
        for: 0 <= k <= 5
            a := try substitute(&context, numerator, [variable], [point])
            b := try substitute(&context, denominator, [variable], [point])
            if not is_zero(context, b)
                result := try combine_product(&context, [a, try normal_power(&context, b, constant(&context, -1))])
                return ["limit: " + show(context, result)]
            if not is_zero(context, a)
                return ["limit: unbounded"]
            if k == 5
                return ["limit: unknown"]
            numerator = try derivative(&context, numerator, variable)
            denominator = try derivative(&context, denominator, variable)
    if command == "TAYLOR"
        order := try order_field(fields[3])
        derivatives := [expression]
        for: i < order
            derivatives = derivatives.append(try derivative(&context, derivatives[-1], variable))
        point_value := context.nodes[point]
        negative_point := rational(&context, -point_value.numerator, point_value.denominator)
        offset := try combine_sum(&context, [make_variable(&context, variable), negative_point])
        factorial := 1
        int[] polynomial := []
        for: 0 <= k <= order
            if k > 0
                factorial *= k
            value := try substitute(&context, derivatives[k], [variable], [point])
            coefficient := try combine_product(&context, [value, rational(&context, 1, factorial)])
            term := try combine_product(&context, [coefficient, try normal_power(&context, offset, constant(&context, k))])
            polynomial = polynomial.append(term)
        sum := try combine_sum(&context, polynomial)
        return ["taylor: " + show(context, try expand(&context, sum))]
    return error("wrong number of arguments")

string number_of_commands
scan(&number_of_commands)
context := Context()
for: int index < int(number_of_commands)
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match process_command(&context, line)
        string[] output
            for item := output[]
                println(item)
        error problem
            println("error: {problem.message}")
